test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: Which district has secured the first rank in the country for conducting awareness activities under the eighth National Nutrition Fortnight campaign?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ahilyanagar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Maharashtra’s Ahilyanagar district** ranks first in the **National Nutrition Fortnight awareness campaign**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ahilyanagar district** of **Maharashtra** has secured the **first rank in the country** for conducting awareness activities under the **eighth National Nutrition Fortnight campaign**.
 
• The district recorded a massive total of **324,075 activities** to secure this top position.
 
• **Pune district** achieved the **second position** nationwide in the same awareness campaign.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The campaign is being implemented by the **Women and Child Development Department**.
 
• This year’s **Nutrition Fortnight** is uniquely centered around the theme **“Brain Development in the First Six Years of a Child’s Life.”**
 
• Information regarding the district's performance and ranking was officially provided by the **Zilla Parishad Chief Executive Officer Gajanan Patil**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The top two spots nationwide for the **National Nutrition Fortnight** were both secured by districts in **Maharashtra** (**Ahilyanagar** and **Pune**).
 
• The primary focus of the awareness activities aligned with the crucial early brain development in young children.
